metadata.description: Agent Accelerator — a Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: accelerator-core
plugins.description: Core Agent Accelerator skills: speak-aloud (read Claude's output via TTS, incl. Docker→host bridge), remote-ssh-ops (safe remote work over SSH) and secrets-cli (look up credentials in the local sops+age store before asking).

plugins.name: accelerator-loops
plugins.description: Claude Loops: repeatable, verified workflows around the model. Scaffold a claude-loops/ workspace and drive loops (create, run, status, stop, remove) via slash commands.

plugins.name: simple-english
plugins.description: Write or rewrite technical text with ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, one word one meaning, active voice, condition before command. Re-published from AminBlg/SimpleEnglish, pinned.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's agent skills for real engineering: grilling, spec/ticket flows, TDD, code review, domain modelling and more. Re-published from mattpocock/skills, pinned.

plugins.name: gh-skills
plugins.description: GitHub CLI agent skills (gh, gh-skill). Re-published from cli/cli, pinned; replaces the gh skill install in dotfiles-mise.

plugins.name: tokeneconomizer
plugins.description: Cost control for coding agents: micro-skills (repo facts learned from earlier sessions), pruning of tools a repo never uses, and a failure-loop guard. Re-published from microsoft/TokenEconomizer, pinned.
